# crate-plugin-kit
> A Cargo-based plugin system that installs cdylib plugins from crates.io and loads them at runtime.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/crate-plugin-kit/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/crate-plugin-kit
Status: documented
Last verified: 2026-11-17

- [crate-plugin-kit architecture](https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/crate-plugin-kit/architecture/): Runtime boundaries, package roles, and design facts for crate-plugin-kit.
- [crate-plugin-kit FAQ](https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/crate-plugin-kit/faq/): Common questions about crate-plugin-kit, its intended use, setup, runtime boundary, and source of truth.
